chazz-darkness-armed-dragon-ojama.name: Armed Dragon and Ojama
chazz-darkness-armed-dragon-ojama.blurb: Chazz's deck on his return: the Armed Dragon LV3 to LV10 line with Masked Dragon, surrounded by Ojamas and Ojama Trio to buy time.

chazz-dimension-world-ojama-union.name: Ojama, Armed Dragon and Union
chazz-dimension-world-ojama-union.blurb: Chazz's most loaded version: Ojamas, Armed Dragon LV7 and LV10, the V-W-X-Y-Z Union series and Chthonian Soldier, with Dark Blade as the Fusion card.

chazz-society-of-light-vwxyz-armed-drago.name: VWXYZ, Ojama and Armed Dragon
chazz-society-of-light-vwxyz-armed-drago.blurb: Chazz's deck against the Society of Light: the V, W, X, Y and Z Unions that form VWXYZ-Dragon Catapult Cannon, the Armed Dragon line and the Ojama team with Ojama King.

crowler-ancient-gear.name: Ancient Gear
crowler-ancient-gear.blurb: Crowler's deck (Dr. Crowler): Ancient Gear Golem, Soldier and Beast, backed by Ancient Gear Castle, with Ultimate Ancient Gear Golem as the final Fusion.

jaden-darkness-neos-yubel.name: Neos and Yubel
jaden-darkness-neos-yubel.blurb: The deck of the final stretch: Neos and the Neo-Spacians with Contact Fusion, Elemental HERO Divine Neos and Rainbow Neos, and Yubel as the card that ties the duel to his past.

jaden-dimension-world-evil-hero.name: Evil HERO
jaden-dimension-world-evil-hero.blurb: The deck Jaden uses as the Supreme King: Evil HEROes that come out of Dark Fusion, with Evil HERO Dark Gaia and Infernal Sniper as signature cards.

jaden-seven-stars-elemental-hero.name: Elemental HERO
jaden-seven-stars-elemental-hero.blurb: The deck with which Jaden wins his first duels at Duel Academy: Elemental HEROes that fuse with Polymerization and Miracle Fusion up to Flame Wingman and Thunder Giant.

jaden-society-of-light-elemental-hero.name: Classic Elemental HERO
jaden-society-of-light-elemental-hero.blurb: The usual Elemental HERO in the fight against the Society of Light: the basic HEROes with Polymerization, Miracle Fusion and Metamorphosis to bring out Flame Wingman, Thunder Giant and Wild Wingman.

jesse-advanced-crystal-beast.name: Advanced Crystal Beast
jesse-advanced-crystal-beast.blurb: The dark version of Jesse's deck, with the seven Advanced Crystal Beasts, the Advanced Dark field and Rainbow Dark Dragon as the final card.

jesse-crystal-beast.name: Crystal Beast
jesse-crystal-beast.blurb: Jesse's deck: the seven Crystal Beasts that, when destroyed, are placed as gems in the Spell and Trap Zone and come together in Rainbow Dragon.

jim-fossil-thematic.name: Jim's Fossils
jim-fossil-thematic.blurb: Jim, a paleontologist from South Academy, plays Fossil: Fossil Fusion fuses monsters from the Graveyard into fossil dragons, machines and warriors.
jim-fossil-thematic.basis: Jim plays a Fossil deck (wiki, Fossil Deck). The deck starts from that list, replaces the cards that only exist in the anime with printed Fossil cards and fills out with what real Fossil lists play (Fossil Dig, Skull Knight, Skull Wagon).

nightshroud-red-eyes-thematic.name: Nightshroud's Red-Eyes
nightshroud-red-eyes-thematic.blurb: Nightshroud, while possessing Atticus, plays Red-Eyes and goes for Red-Eyes Darkness Dragon, the dragon that grows with every dragon in the Graveyard.
nightshroud-red-eyes-thematic.basis: Nightshroud plays a Red-Eyes deck with Red-Eyes Darkness Dragon (wiki, seasons 1 and 2). The deck starts from that deck, swaps the anime-only cards for printed Red-Eyes cards and adds the "Masked Darkness Dragon" deck from Tag Force. There is no real Red-Eyes list with this strategy: the filler is zero.

sartorius-arcana-force.name: Arcana Force
sartorius-arcana-force.blurb: Sartorius's deck: the Arcana Force, whose effect depends on the coin, with The Chariot, The Emperor and The World as closing cards.

syrus-cyberdark-vehicroid.name: Cyberdark Vehicroid
syrus-cyberdark-vehicroid.blurb: The deck Syrus inherits from his brother: Cyber Dragon and the Cyberdark join the Vehicroid, with Cyberdark Dragon and Chimeratech Overdragon to close.

syrus-vehicroid-roids.name: Vehicroid
syrus-vehicroid-roids.blurb: Syrus's Vehicroid deck: Cycroid, Jetroid and company unite with Vehicroid Connection Zone and Power Bond into Super Vehicroid Jumbo Drill and Stealth Union.

tania-amazoness-thematic.name: Tania's Amazoness
tania-amazoness-thematic.blurb: Tania, the allied Shadow Rider, plays Amazoness with two decks, Courage and Knowledge. The deck unites both with Amazoness Swords Woman, Paladin and Tiger.
tania-amazoness-thematic.basis: Tania uses two Amazoness decks (wiki, episodes 36-37). The deck starts from the Deck of Courage, adds the cards of the Deck of Knowledge, replaces anime-only cards with printed Amazoness support and fills out with monsters of the archetype.

titan-archfiend-thematic.name: Titan's Archfiend
titan-archfiend-thematic.blurb: Titan, the Archfiend Shadow Rider, plays Skull Archfiend of Lightning and Desrook Archfiend with Archfiend's Oath and Pandemonium.
titan-archfiend-thematic.basis: Titan plays an Archfiend deck (wiki, episodes 5, 6 and 41). The deck gathers the anime's Archfiends that exist in the TCG and the "Underworld Bark" deck from Spirit Caller; it is not filled out with modern lists because none shares his strategy.

tyranno-evolution-dinosaur.name: Dinosaurs
tyranno-evolution-dinosaur.blurb: Tyranno's deck: dinosaurs that grow huge with Ultra Evolution Pill and Big Evolution Pill, with Ultimate Tyranno and Super Conductor Tyranno as closing beasts.

yubel-fiend-plant.name: Fiend and Plant
yubel-fiend-plant.blurb: Yubel's deck: Yubel in her three forms alongside Fiend and Plant monsters like Gate Guardian, Raviel and Samsara Lotus, with Super Polymerization as the key.

zane-cyber-art-cyber-dragon.name: Cyber Dragon
zane-cyber-art-cyber-dragon.blurb: Zane's deck at the Academy: Cyber Dragon, Power Bond and Cyber End Dragon, with Cyber Twin Dragon and Chimeratech Overdragon as finishers.

zane-underworld-cyberdark.name: Cyberdark
zane-underworld-cyberdark.blurb: Zane's deck in the Underworld: Cyberdark Edge, Horn and Keel equipped to Cyber Dragon, and Chimeratech Fortress Dragon and Overdragon as closing cards.

akiza-standing-black-rose.name: Black Rose Dragon
akiza-standing-black-rose.blurb: Akiza's Plant deck, the Witch: Evil Thorn and Wall of Ivy, Black Garden and Black Rose Dragon to wipe the field.

aporia-nexus-land.name: Meklord Emperor Granel
aporia-nexus-land.blurb: Jakob's (Aporia) deck in Over the Nexus: low-level beasts like Berserk Gorilla and King Tiger Wanghu to support Meklord Emperor Granel.
aporia-nexus-land.basis: Thematic deck: the anime shows no deck for this character. It is built from the list he uses in the video game (Over the Nexus) and the cards that define him.

aporia-nexus-ruler.name: Meklord Emperor Wisel
aporia-nexus-ruler.blurb: Primo's (Aporia) deck in Over the Nexus: Archfiend General, Playful Possum and Thunder Nyan Nyan with Meklord Emperor Wisel as the main card.
aporia-nexus-ruler.basis: Thematic deck: the anime shows no deck for this character. It is built from the list he uses in the video game (Over the Nexus) and the cards that define him.

aporia-nexus-sky.name: Meklord Emperor Skiel
aporia-nexus-sky.blurb: Lester's (Aporia) deck in Over the Nexus: Cloudian and Arcana Force 0 - The Fool to support Meklord Emperor Skiel.
aporia-nexus-sky.basis: Thematic deck: the anime shows no deck for this character. It is built from the list he uses in the video game (Over the Nexus) and the cards that define him.

aporia-transer-genex.name: Genex Ally and Ally of Justice (Primo)
aporia-transer-genex.blurb: Iliaster in his Primo form, in Duel Transer: Genex Ally (Changer, Remote, Duradark, Chemistrer) and Ally of Justice with DNA Transplant and Machine Duplication, finishing with Catastor. It is a playable version with printed cards, not a deck shown in the anime.
aporia-transer-genex.basis: Primo's (Aporia) list in Duel Transer, "Iliaster's Frission of Terror", as the wiki records it; every card is from that list.

aporia-transer-monarch.name: Monarchs and Genex (Lester)
aporia-transer-monarch.blurb: Iliaster in his Lester form, in Duel Transer: Monarchs (Caius, Raiza, Thestalos), Genex Undine and Genex Controller with Instant Fusion to reach the Genex Allies. It is a playable version with printed cards, not a deck shown in the anime.
aporia-transer-monarch.basis: Lester's (Aporia) list in Duel Transer, "Iliaster's Awakening", as the wiki records it; every card is from that list.

aporia-transer-scrap.name: Scrap (Jakob)
aporia-transer-scrap.blurb: Iliaster in his Jakob form, in Duel Transer: the Scrap archetype (Scrapstorm, Scrapyard, Scrap Lube) to recycle Scrap Dragon and Scrap Twin Dragon, with Geartown and Nephthys support. It is a playable version with printed cards, not a deck shown in the anime.
aporia-transer-scrap.basis: Jakob's (Aporia) list in Duel Transer, "Iliaster's Strategem", as the wiki records it; every card is from that list.

bruno-tg-synchro.name: T.G. (Tech Genus)
bruno-tg-synchro.blurb: The T.G. deck Bruno uses in the anime: Striker, Cyber Magician and Jet Falcon tuners to Synchro quickly, Hyper Librarian to draw and Blade Blaster for the Accel Synchro.

bruno-transer-hope.name: Warriors of Hope
bruno-transer-hope.blurb: Bruno's deck in Duel Transer: warriors like Marauding Captain and Armageddon Knight, Junk Synchron in three copies and the Synchros Junk Warrior, X-Saber Wayne and Gaia Knight.
bruno-transer-hope.basis: Thematic deck: the anime shows no deck for this character. It is built from the list he uses in the video game (Duel Transer) and the cards that define him.

carly-arcadia-fortunetelling.name: Fortune Ladies
carly-arcadia-fortunetelling.blurb: Carly's deck: Fortune Ladies of all five attributes, Fortune's Future, Future Visions and Solidarity, with Catoblepas and the Witch of Fate.
carly-arcadia-fortunetelling.basis: Thematic deck: the anime shows no deck for this character. It is built from the list she uses in the video game (Reverse of Arcadia) and the cards that define her.

carly-transfer-fate.name: Destiny and Fortune
carly-transfer-fate.blurb: Carly's deck with the Fortune Ladies and Earthbound Immortal Aslla piscu, backed by Future Visions, Bending Destiny and Slip of Fortune.

devack-arcadia-apes.blurb: Devack's deck: Apes like Berserk Gorilla and Voltic Kong, Earthbound Immortal Cusillu and Zeman the Ape King.

jack-wcq-resonator-archfiend.name: Resonators and Red Dragon Archfiend
jack-wcq-resonator-archfiend.blurb: Jack's scripted-duel deck at the 2017 WCQ: the whole Resonator family and the evolutions of Red Dragon Archfiend (Hot, Scarlight, Tyrant).

kalin-dark-signer-infernity.name: Infernity and Ccapac Apu
kalin-dark-signer-infernity.blurb: Kalin's deck as a Dark Signer: Infernity Archfiend, Beetle and Mirage with an empty hand, Infernity Doom Dragon and Hundred Eyes Dragon, alongside Earthbound Immortal Ccapac Apu.
kalin-dark-signer-infernity.basis: Thematic deck: the anime shows no deck for this character. It is built from the list he uses in the video game (Dark Signer) and the cards that define him.

kalin-nexus-archfiend.name: Archfiends of the Enforcers
kalin-nexus-archfiend.blurb: Kalin's "The Enforcing Ones" deck in Over the Nexus: Archfiend Soldier, Desrook, Terrorking and Skull Archfiend of Lightning with Pandemonium and Hate Buster. A Fiend deck very different from his Infernity. It is a playable version with printed cards, not a deck shown in the anime.
kalin-nexus-archfiend.basis: Kalin's "The Enforcing Ones" list in Over the Nexus, as the wiki records it; every card is from that list.

kalin-nexus-demise.name: The Master's Infernity
kalin-nexus-demise.blurb: Kalin's Infernity deck in Over the Nexus: Archfiend, Guardian and Necromancer in three copies and Infernity Doom Dragon to finish.
kalin-nexus-demise.basis: Thematic deck: the anime shows no deck for this character. It is built from the list he uses in the video game (Over the Nexus) and the cards that define him.

lazar-transer-clown.name: Clown Festival
lazar-transer-clown.blurb: Lazar's deck: Clowns like Jester Confit, Jester Lord and Mystic Tomato, with Stumbling, Imperial Custom and Xing Zhen Hu to cut off the opponent.
lazar-transer-clown.basis: Thematic deck: the anime shows no deck for this character. It is built from the list he uses in the video game (Duel Transer) and the cards that define him.

leo-arcadia-morphtronic.name: Morphtronic and Power Tool Dragon
leo-arcadia-morphtronic.blurb: Leo's deck: low-level Morphtronics (Celfon, Radion, Boarden) and Tuners to bring out Power Tool Dragon, with Double Tool C&D and Morphtronic Accelerator.
leo-arcadia-morphtronic.basis: Thematic deck: the anime shows no deck for this character. It is built from the list he uses in the video game (Reverse of Arcadia) and the cards that define him.

leo-nexus-equipped.name: Equipped Morphtronic
leo-nexus-equipped.blurb: Leo's deck in Over the Nexus: Morphtronics with United We Stand and Mage Power, Morphtronic Bind and Power Tool Dragon in three copies.
leo-nexus-equipped.basis: Thematic deck: the anime shows no deck for this character. It is built from the list he uses in the video game (Over the Nexus) and the cards that define him.

leo-stardust-chimeratech.name: Morphtronic and Chimeratech
leo-stardust-chimeratech.blurb: Leo's deck in Stardust Accelerator: Morphtronics, Cyber Dragon and the fusions Chimeratech Fortress Dragon and Chimeratech Overdragon with Overload Fusion.
leo-stardust-chimeratech.basis: Thematic deck: the anime shows no deck for this character. It is built from the list he uses in the video game (Stardust Accelerator) and the cards that define him.

luna-decade-spirits.name: Forest Spirits
luna-decade-spirits.blurb: Luna's deck in Decade Duels: Fairies and Sunny Pixie, Counselor Lily, Ancient Forest and the Synchros Ancient Fairy Dragon and Ancient Sacred Wyvern.
luna-decade-spirits.basis: Thematic deck: the anime shows no deck for this character. It is built from the list she uses in the video game (Decade Duels) and the cards that define her.

luna-online-rustling.name: The Rustling Forest
luna-online-rustling.blurb: Luna's deck in Yu-Gi-Oh! Online: Fire Princess, Sunlight Unicorn and Nimble Momonga with Ancient Forest, Dimension Wall and Magic Drain, a control deck different from her spirit war. It is a playable version with printed cards, not a deck shown in the anime.
luna-online-rustling.basis: Luna's "ざわめく森" (the rustling forest) list in Yu-Gi-Oh! Online, as the wiki records it; every card is from that list.

luna-transer-spirits.name: Spirit War
luna-transer-spirits.blurb: Luna's deck in Duel Transer: Shining Angel, Soul of Purity and Light, Wattkiwi and Sunny Pixie to summon Ancient Fairy Dragon and Ancient Sacred Wyvern.
luna-transer-spirits.basis: Thematic deck: the anime shows no deck for this character. It is built from the list she uses in the video game (Duel Transer) and the cards that define her.

luna-transer-stand.name: The Forest Spirits
luna-transer-stand.blurb: Luna's deck with Fire Princess, Dancing Fairy and Cure Mermaid, protected by Messenger of Peace and Ancient Forest, with Ancient Fairy Dragon.
luna-transer-stand.basis: Thematic deck: the anime shows no deck for this character. It is built from the list she uses in the video game (Duel Transer) and the cards that define her.

misty-tredwell-thematic.name: Reptilianne and Dragon Queen
misty-tredwell-thematic.blurb: Misty Tredwell, as a Dark Signer, uses a Reptilianne deck that cuts the opponent's ATK to 0, with Dragon Queen of Tragic Endings and Earthbound Immortal Ccarayhua. This is a playable version with printed cards, not a deck shown in the anime.
misty-tredwell-thematic.basis: Her anime Reptilianne deck (Gardna, Gorgon, Servant, Spawn, Rage, Dragon Queen of Tragic Endings, Ccarayhua), completed with the rest of the Reptilianne archetype and the support cards the wiki recommends; there are no Reptilianne tournament decks in our data.

rex-goodwin-thematic.name: Earthbound Immortals of the Incas
rex-goodwin-thematic.blurb: Rex Goodwin, as a Dark Signer, uses an Inca deck with Sun Dragon Inti and Moon Dragon Quilla, and Earthbound Immortal Wiraqocha Rasca as the ace. This is a playable version with printed cards, not a deck shown in the anime.
rex-goodwin-thematic.basis: His anime Inca deck (Wiraqocha Rasca, Oracle of the Sun, Weeping Idol, Fire Ant Ascator, Inti and Quilla) plus the monsters of Rex's deck in Duel Links, and counterattack traps the anime shows him.

roman-arcadia-spider.name: Spider Web
roman-arcadia-spider.blurb: Roman Goodwin's deck: Spiders like Jirai Gumo and Spyder Spider, Spider Egg and Earthbound Immortal Uru with Underground Arachnid as the Synchro.
roman-arcadia-spider.basis: Thematic deck: the anime shows no deck for this character. It is built from the list he uses in the video game (Reverse of Arcadia) and the cards that define him.

roman-transfer-sacrifice.name: Web of Sacrifice
roman-transfer-sacrifice.blurb: Roman's Spider deck with Howling Insect, Mother Spider, Spider Web and Underground Arachnid in three copies.
roman-transfer-sacrifice.basis: Thematic deck: the anime shows no deck for this character. It is built from the list he uses in the video game (Duel Transfer) and the cards that define him.

sherry-leblanc-thematic.name: Noble Knights and Fleur
sherry-leblanc-thematic.blurb: Sherry competes in Turbo Duels with her knights and the Fleur monsters, and in Duel Links she uses a knight deck with Fleur Synchron and Chevalier de Fleur. This is a playable version with printed cards, not a deck shown in the anime.
sherry-leblanc-thematic.basis: Her Turbo deck from the anime (Fleur Synchron, Horse of the Floral Knights, Centaur Mina, Chevalier de Fleur) with the Noble Knights that are her Sacred Knights in the TCG, the Fleur and field cards of her Ground deck, and the cards of her Duel Links decks.

tetsu-decade-officer.name: Security Officer
tetsu-decade-officer.blurb: Trudge's deck in Decade Duels: Command Knight, Marauding Captain and Torapart, with Colossal Fighter and Goyo Guardian as Synchros.
tetsu-decade-officer.basis: Thematic deck: the anime shows no deck for this character. It is built from the list he uses in the video game (Decade Duels) and the cards that define him.

tetsu-tf5-stygian.name: Stygian Guard (Forced Search)
tetsu-tf5-stygian.blurb: Trudge's deck in Tag Force 5: Stygian Security, Stygian Street Patrol and Stygian Sergeants with Search Striker, Samurai Sword Baron, No Entry!! and Security Orb. It is a playable version with printed cards, not a deck shown in the anime.
tetsu-tf5-stygian.basis: Trudge's "Coerced Search" list in Tag Force 5, as the wiki records it; every card is from that list.
